defs.def: the amount of money that is available to a person, an organization or a government to spend 资金；财源；备用款

ex.s: Some people believe that while space exploration expands our understanding of the universe, it is a waste of the public purse and does nothing to enhance the quality of our lives here on the Earth.
ex.t: 有些人认为，虽然太空探索扩大了我们对宇宙的理解，但它浪费了公共资金，对提高我们在地球上的生活质量毫无帮助。
